methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.rationale: Median across 6 same-sector + similar-valuation-tier peers in AI & Software. Range: $8.3B - $39.0B.

public.rationale: Public-co frontier-tech comp in AI & Compute

data.narrative:
Scale AI, a private AI & Software company founded by Alexandr Wang and Lucy Guo, is currently valued at $29B having raised $14.8B to date. The peer-median valuation method was applied using six same-sector, similar-valuation-tier comparables including Figure AI ($39.0B Series C), Reflection AI ($25.0B Series A), Applied Intuition ($15.0B Series F), Skild AI ($14.0B Series C), and Crusoe Energy ($10.0B Series C), alongside one additional peer. The peer sample spans a range of $8.3B to $39.0B.

The peer-median method yielded an implied valuation of $14.5B, derived from the median of the six-company cohort. This single triangulation method constrains a conservative valuation band of $12.3B to $16.7B, with the $14.5B median as the central point estimate. The comp universe included one public reference point (Palantir, ticker PLTR) and eight private peers, providing directional context though limited public market anchoring.

Scale AI's current $29B valuation substantially exceeds the peer-derived range by approximately 100%, suggesting either material differentiation in execution, growth trajectory, or market positioning not captured by median comparables, or valuation expansion driven by recent fundraising dynamics. Key uncertainties include revenue multiples, customer concentration, and whether the peer set adequately reflects Scale AI's profitability path or competitive moat relative to the Figure AI outlier at $39.0B.
